mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals labor market slack and weak consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE >= 9.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (both above 3-month moving averages) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate profit visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
